title: An arrow label overlaps a vertical arrow
body: `Connector::draw` in `crates/acre/src/scene/diagram.rs` centres a label 6 px above the midpoint of its line. On a vertical arrow the text sits across the line. One fix offsets the label along the line's normal and picks the text alignment from the side it lands on.
close_reason: Fixed in 6e74f14. A label is offset along the line's normal by its measured extent, so it clears a vertical or diagonal line. Unit tests cover vertical, diagonal and horizontal lines.
